reviews.title: Watch you hand luggage size flying from YVN
reviews.text: We’ve been sitting in the business lounge in Yerevan Zvartnots International Airport watching people boarding their flights from the floor above. All of the sudden we saw a huge congestion of people around a gate with a flight departing to Rostov, it was a flight operated by NordWind. We noticed that the gate agents were asking every passenger to put their hand luggage bag in a measuring box. Every single passenger. We were very surprised as we have never seen such a policy so strictly enforced and disorganized. What was upsetting to see is the last passenger - he was an older gentleman having one duffel bag and a duty free bag, the gate agents told him that he can only have one bag and made him so upset that he had to throw away his duty free goods in a trash can. Anyway, the airline itself looked nice on the outside, and we were curious to try flying with them, but definitely not from the Yerevan airport. Our advice is to watch your hand luggage size closely. Hope you’ll have a much more pleasant flight than that older gentleman.
reviews.author: Vera W

No compensation, water, food or anything else provided. Wait time is already over 8 hours. No apology. It took 3 hours for a staff member to emerge who wasn’t of any help. reviews.title: An airlines I would rate below Ryan air
reviews.text: The service with this air line was really poor the flight was delayed and the on board service was very unimpressive and our baggage was damaged coming back into Gatwick. When I filled out a damage form and when we got to the car we saw another case had been damaged however when we spoke the Norwegian air lines about it they said that they wouldn't consider it even though the rep at the airport had said to the baggage operators that there had been a number of problems. However even the one case they knew about and saw at the airport they asked for photos and other docs and then said that it would be a month before we got the paid but it still took them 3 weeks to make this decision . Since they don't sign up to any arbitration agreement I can't go to the C A A, since they wouldn't take on this matter and the cases value would be only a small amount more than the excess. When I emailed them repeated about the reason for the payment taking so long they never gave me an answer, and didn't bother to reply . I wouldn't use this company again due to the way I have been treated over a very straightforward matter. I would rate them below Ryan air !
reviews.author: Huw W

reviews.title: 20% of the flights seats didn't exist, we had to stand and wait in the cabin to be randomly assigned seats.
reviews.text: Where to begin... As the title suggests, on board this flight a number of passengers seats simply didn't exist. Presumably the plane plan on the computer differed to the layout of the plane on the tarmac so after some time the pilot says (in Russian only) to "find and take a seat" to the 20% of us left standing. Cue the stampede of passengers falling over each other to get a vacant seat. The one I found and sat in was actually assigned to a straggling passenger so most of us had to stand up once again and wait. Eventually airport staff (not the stewardess who were nowhere to be seen_ began filling up the seats similar to how they do on a rollercoaster at a theme park. By hollering "we have a 2 over here!" and "one seat here!" slowly we all were in random seats seperated from our groups. This was especially dissappointing for those who had paid for emergency exit seats and didn't receive them. The next grievance: The cabin itself was extremely hot the entire journey with no option to turn on extra air to cool. The final issue: Many people had ordered additional meals as one hot meal for a 12 hour flight provided as standard isn't enough. So I'd paid in advance for a meal, but of course the meals are assigned to seat numbers which 20% of the plane were in random seats so receiving your meal on this flight was like being in the bingo hall. "Can Elena Biriukov make herself known to crew" and "can Roman Popov make himself known to the crew" repeat x 50 Unfortunately I did not receive my meal and was told that my name was "not on the list" This was unfortunate as I'd been charged 1000 rubles 48 hours prior for some fish and a limp lettuce leaf and now I wasn't even going to get that. Oddly, the stweardess asked to see a copy of my receipt for the meal, which I showed to her, only for her to shrug her shoulders and still say "no". So why ask to see the receipt if even with the receipt the situation wouldn't have changed? I was told that I need to apply to them for a refund, while that may be true, it's of little comfort to my hunger pangs at the time! Be aware that the stewardesses do not come through the cabin with water as standard. You will need to get up and go to the back of the plane to request each time you want a cup of water. They would not let me refill my water bottle with their water to save on wasting paper cups. In that case, surely it would be more logical for the stewardess to pre pour cups of water and leave them on a tray for passengers to collect? Please do not expect an international airline experience, the staff cannot speak English even at a basic level. Not a single apology was offered throughout the whole flight. The staff just look disgruntled to be frank, I appreciate the job for them throughout this whole situation must have been frustrating and stressful for them too but their approach was just unsavoury and left a lasting bad impression. Passengers will forgive everything if the staff are good humored and pleasant- Nordwind Airlines customer service training has completely missed the point.

But, next time I just buy some thing as the airport as their meal (sandwiches) are not eatable. If you like a low budget flight , they are good. you get what you pay for.

reviews.author: Frederick H

reviews.title: not the best way to get from moscow to st pete
reviews.text: I couldn't resist trying out a new airline, and the price was okay. I got the cheapest ticket with just hand luggage, and the staff complained that I had a laptop bag in addition to a cabin size suitcase. I'm not gonna put my laptop in a suitcase, okay? You have to pay for a seat in order to register online, and I managed to get one without a window, grrr. (12A) I did get some amazing views over Strelna while landing. I don't recommend buying a meal for short flights like this one. The passengers who did that got their meals so late that I think they didn't finish them. Best bring your own food (or get it delivered to your gate). Sheremetyevo happens to be my least favourite Moscow airport, so I'm unlikely to fly with them again unless the destination/price is too good (Reus?). Preferably with checked luggage.
reviews.author: Marina J

reviews.title: Check-in From Hell
reviews.text: Never had a worse check-in. It was so S-L-O-W. The reason was that EVERYTHING is weighed so that they can charge you for "excess weight." That means that my snacks (you have to pay for snacks and/or meal on Norwegian), my purse, my pillow, etc. were all weighed. The mother with kids ahead of me had to surrender her children's stuffed animals for the weigh-in!!! The kids were screaming in panic. What a nightmare.
reviews.author: Kim D

reviews.title: Ehhh...
reviews.text: Nordwind is okay. It was the most affordable option to fly from the Caucasus to Saint Petersburg at the time. Check in and boarding was fine, and the majority of the flight was pleasant (except for some crying babies). I thought that our pilot was not too good because they had to make a strong last minute correction with the rudder when landing even though (as I checked on my phone once taxing) the crosswinds were normal. This made some people noticeably alarmed. Overall, I would recommend Nordwind if it is the cheapest or most convenient option. If your starting/ending city is Moscow, I would recommend something like Aeroflot or S7 instead.
reviews.author: Third Class Ethan

reviews.title: Garbage airline with zero customer service

reviews.author: alexa-v-k

reviews.title: Excellent flight on Norwegian
reviews.text: Excellent, efficient flight. Basic services - one has to pay extra for everything, but even so it is a real bargain. R/T friends flew with me with no meals, no selected seat and no checked baggage for $406 I paid about $700 R/T with checked bag both ways and selected seat both ways. Still a bargain from Denver. Meals $45 each way and I didn't see the point for airplane food. One can order from the screen at reasonable prices. I ordered water for $3 and took along a couple of snacks, dining at the airport before take-off. If would fly Norwegian again. Boeing Dreamliner.
reviews.author: christine_leatherman

reviews.title: Not a Norwegian Plane 😬
reviews.text: We were supposed to fly on a Norwegian 787 with entertainment. When we arrived at the jetway we saw a Prestige Style 777 with no amenities other than a lunch that we paid for. Nine hours on a plane with no internet, no movies or music is pure torture.

reviews.title: The good the bad and the ugly
reviews.text: we flew out of Gatwick on 12 April 2019 and on the face of the welcome were looking forward to the flight - then we took off. There we obviously staff in training. Food ordered before flight were awaited but all adult meals were handed out before the air stewards reached our seats, all that was left was childrens sausages and beans, with the only excuse given by argumentative staff was that the food orders were not binding and errors in supply must have happened. Teas and coffee served were luke warm - beware this does not happen to you, 10 hrs in a plane with children and hungry adults is a long time to endure. The return trip was a smooth pleasure - hurrah

reviews.author: pjeremyandrews

reviews.title: Cheap Flight that costs alot.
reviews.text: This is a very poor airline to travel on. We had booked our flight almost a year before we were traveling and got to pick our seats for an extra charge. We got very good seats and were real happy until we got the email about 4 months before leaving that they changed the time of the flight from 3:20 p.m. to 9:20 p.m. That time change caused us to miss our connecting flight in London. We were suppose to arrive in Oslo at 12:20 p.m. but because of the change we got to Oslo at 8:40 p.m. We lost an entire day of our vacation. Not to mention that we paid extra to pick our seats, and when they changed our flight they moved us to different seats. We had bid to get an upgrade to business class and they took our money, but then gave our seats away to someone else and we didn't get what we had paid for. It was a real problem getting our money back for the upgrade. Once we arrived in Oslo, we got our luggage and it was totally destroyed. We tried to report the damage but the person we talked to said they didn't work for Norwegian and we needed to report it on line. When I tried to report it on line, they told me I was suppose to have reported it to a person at the airport. The air crew was very nice. We got our meal, but everything else was extra. Well not water, but coffee and soda was extra. They are cheap to fly with, but it is a cheap company. I will not fly with them again. I am going back to American Airlines. :
reviews.author: Randy W

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.text: We flew from Denver to London direct and then back from Paris to Denver on this particular trip. Overall I would say Norwegian does what you can expect for the price you pay. A round trip ticket business here cost about the same as economy with say United so we werent expecting the same level of service and amenites. The loading process is a bit messy with people just crowding the door, and both our flights loaded late and took off later. The staff were pleasant and do their best to make the flight easy and enjoyable. The food is lacking, there is really no other way to put it. On our flight home I didnt even eat the dinner and I am truly not a picky eater. I would certainly fly with them again as it is nearly impossibly to beat the price but just dont have your expectations too high.
reviews.author: Jessica L
